Job Objective

The incumbent will be responsible to generate new business and strengthen existing client relationship.

Responsibilities

  • To plan, monitor and manage new and existing account relationship in order to optimize return.
  • To actively cross sell and promote products and services of the Bank.
  • Deliver quality underwriting recommendations based on sound judgment, and a systematic and consistent approach in line with Bank’s credit policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the facility’s regulatory administration and legal documentation, prepared for the purpose of ensuring bank’s exposure to client is legitimate and enforceable.
  • Proactively identify new business opportunities and onboard suitable clients

Job Dimensions

  • Develop marketing plan, call on target customers, negotiate and structure new deals.
  • Evaluate and assess additional exposure to new relationships as well as existing relationships. Monitor the continuing risk and conduct reviews.
  • Maximize return from the relationship profile by cross selling and promoting the products and services of the Bank.
  • Perform timely facility documentation and administration, ensuring adherence to prevailing laws and banking regulations. Servicing customers and attend to their banking requirements.

Experience

  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in corporate banking, with a proven track record of success
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the full range of banking products & industry knowledge.
  • Good risk assessment skills.
  • Familiar with China policies and regulations.
  • Experience in cross selling investment banking products.

Education And Relevant Experience

University graduate with major in either Banking, Finance or Accounting.

Core Competencies

Results oriented.

Effective communication and problem solving technique.

Sharp business & customer focus.

Technical Competencies

Credit risk assessment.

Related Industry knowledge.

Responsibilities.

Location:

PRC - Shenzhen

Job:

Relationship Management

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

Job Summary

The Product Owner, Digital Wealth and Fund, is responsible for shaping and delivering client-centric digital wealth and fund journeys across mobile and web channels. The role owns the product vision, roadmap and backlog for digital investment propositions, including fund discovery, transaction journeys, portfolio servicing and post-sales engagement, ensuring solutions are aligned to business priorities, client needs, regulatory expectations and technology strategy.

The role acts as the bridge between wealth management business teams, investment product stakeholders, technology, design, risk, compliance and country teams. It translates business outcomes into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, prioritises delivery based on client value and commercial impact, and drives execution through Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, release governance and post-implementation performance tracking.

The role requires strong digital wealth and fund domain knowledge, including understanding of investment products, client suitability, risk profiling, fund order flows, subscription and redemption processes, fees and charges, regulatory disclosures, cross-market operating requirements and servicing controls. The Product Owner is expected to simplify complex wealth journeys, improve client and frontline experience, and enable scalable platform capabilities across markets.

The candidate should also bring practical AI knowledge and the ability to identify responsible use cases for digital wealth, fund servicing and relationship manager enablement. This includes familiarity with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), predictive analytics and machine learning concepts, with sufficient understanding to work effectively with data science, engineering, architecture, model risk and governance teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Owns the product vision, roadmap and backlog for digital investment propositions, including fund discovery, transaction journeys, portfolio servicing and post-sales engagement, ensuring solutions are aligned to business priorities, client needs, regulatory expectations and technology strategy
  • Maintains a commercial lens over the product, understand and communicate with relevant stakeholders on the commercial performance metrics and viability of products, and drive its adoption.
  • Acts as the bridge between wealth management business teams, investment product stakeholders, technology, design, risk, compliance and country teams.
  • Owns the ‘WHY’ and ensure all members of the squad understand and embrace the vision & mission. The why should be closely aligned to the organization’s overall goals and ambitions.
  • Inspires the squad to continuously thrive in a growth mindset.
  • Sets goals and prioritise the backlog for the squad and create actions plans to target for timely delivery.
  • Bring practical AI knowledge and the ability to identify responsible use cases for digital wealth, fund servicing

Business

  • Act as an Agile Product Owner, owning the product vision, roadmap and backlog for digital wealth and fund propositions, including fund discovery, investment transaction journeys, portfolio servicing and post-sales engagement, to support key wealth and retail banking strategic objectives.
  • Partner closely with wealth management business teams, investment product stakeholders, technology, design, risk, compliance, operations and country teams to deliver client-centric, scalable and commercially viable digital investment solutions.
  • Use delivery and backlog management tools such as ADO to define, prioritise and manage epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria based on business value, client impact, regulatory needs, risk considerations and delivery dependencies.
  • Continuously gather feedback from clients, and country stakeholders to iterate platform capabilities, improve usability and drive adoption across digital wealth and fund journeys.
  • Define product requirements and development roadmaps based on digital wealth expertise, fund domain knowledge, market needs, client suitability, risk profiling, fund order flows, subscription and redemption processes, fees, disclosures and servicing controls.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders and delivery teams to synchronise tasks, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, resolve trade-offs and align delivery expectations across business, technology and control functions.
  • Conduct pre-go-live demos, walkthroughs and readiness sessions with stakeholders, ensuring business, technology, operations, risk, compliance and support teams are aligned for smooth transition, launch and post-launch support.
  • Lead regular review and retrospective sessions to embed a growth mindset, identify delivery improvements, strengthen squad effectiveness and share learnings with the wider Product Owner community.

Processes

  • Clearly aligns squad OKRs & KPIs with stakeholders and senior management, ensure these objectives and targets are well understood and aligned to the nature of your product.
  • Communicates and embed the OKRs and KPIs into every aspect of the product life cycle.
  • Identifies and maps the data sources required to validate and measure the performance of the features.
  • Performs post implementation review with squad, define measurement windows and prepare necessary data & metrics.
  • Translate data insights into prioritized product improvements.

People & Talent

  • Coaches & mentor squad members to continuously uplift capability.
  • Fosters a culture based on trust, psychological safety & collaboration.
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people.
  • Responsibility to review team capacity plans to ensure capabilities are released as per agreement with stakeholders.

Risk Management

  • Awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Is accountable for ensuring compliance and risk adherence of products and services, engage with stakeholders to ensure necessary controls are adhered to and approvals are obtained.
  • Identifies all risks and issues that may impact project viability. Track, manage and report them as per the Bank’s standards.

Governance

  • Adherence to policies and control standards, ensuring compliance and operation within risk tolerance and risk appetite
  • Maintain awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Bank operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Responsible for delivering ‘effective governance’ within the deliverables and possessing the ability to constructively challenge relevant stakeholders and teams effectively.
  • Ability and willingness to work through details with relevant control functions in an open and collaborative manner to achieve the desired governance outcome within the bank’s risk appetite.
  • Work with global teams in Risk, Compliance and COO Office to ensure adherence to the Bank’s Risk framework, in the identification, assessment, mitigation, control and monitoring of risk.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Global WM Product Teams
  • Global and Country Technology teams
  • Product Owners across Digital Wealth Journey
  • Country WM Product Heads
  • Group, Regional and Country WM COO teams

Other Responsibilities

  • Do the right thing: Be brave, be the change; Think client; Live with integrity
  • Never Settle: Continuously improve and innovate; Simplify; Learn from your successes and failures
  • Better together: See more in others; How can I help? Build for the long term

Skills And Experience

  • Agile Product Owner
  • Business Analysis
  • Customer Experience design and user experience principle
  • Scrum or similar Agile development methodology

Qualifications

Training

  • Strong background in digital wealth, retail banking and investment products, with practical experience in fund propositions, client investment journeys and Agile product management.
  • 8 to 10 years of experience in digital product delivery, technology implementation or platform transformation, preferably within wealth management, retail banking or financial services organisations.
  • 8 to 10 years of experience as an Agile Product Owner or similar product delivery role, with proven ability to own product vision, roadmap, backlog prioritisation, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Good understanding of fund domain processes, including fund discovery, suitability, risk profiling, subscription and redemption flows, order handling, fees and charges, disclosures, servicing controls and post-sales engagement.
  • Experience delivering digital journeys across mobile and web channels, including customer experience design, usability improvements, adoption tracking and post-implementation performance reviews.
  • Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and tools such as ADO, with ability to manage epics, features, dependencies, release readiness, go-live support and benefits realisation.
  • Practical knowledge of data analytics and responsible AI concepts, including Generative AI, Large Language Models, Natural Language Processing, Retrieval Augmented Generation, predictive analytics and machine learning, with the ability to identify relevant business use cases.
  • Ability to work effectively with data, technology, architecture, risk, compliance, model governance and control teams to ensure AI-enabled capabilities are explainable, measurable, auditable and aligned to the Bank’s standards.
  • Experience evaluating vendor offerings, emerging technologies, proofs of concept and pilots to support scalable, compliant and client-focused digital wealth solutions.
  • Strong understanding of market trends, client needs, commercial drivers and regulatory considerations, with the ability to shape a compelling value proposition and squad vision.
  • Proven track record of working with cross-functional squads and stakeholders across business, product, technology, design, operations, risk, compliance and country teams to deliver agreed outcomes.
  • Experience coaching and mentoring squad members, supporting continuous improvement and sharing learnings with the wider Product Owner community.

Skills

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance client value, business outcomes, technology feasibility and risk considerations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across multi-functional, multi-cultural and multi-market teams.
  • Strong communication skills, including oral, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex digital wealth, fund and technology topics to a broad audience.
  • Ability to translate client, business and regulatory requirements into clear functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities.
  • Experience designing and improving client journeys for digital wealth, fund investment and portfolio servicing across mobile and web channels.
  • Experience managing delivery with scrum masters, engineers, architects, designers, testers and control partners in an Agile environment.
  • Ability to plan, implement, evaluate and sustain product backlogs to achieve measurable client, business, adoption and risk outcomes.
  • Experience with analytics, AI, NLP or intelligent automation proofs of concept is an advantage, particularly for wealth insights, advisor assist, intelligent search, content summarisation or servicing use cases.
  • Experience in financial services applications, particularly digital wealth, fund platforms, wealth advisory, investment servicing, relationship manager enablement, KYC or client engagement solutions, would be an advantage.

Languages

  • Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required, with strong oral and written communication skills to engage stakeholders, document requirements and support delivery across regions.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Technology Management.

Business:CTO

Principal Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream: Own the programme management of IDP's partnerships workstream feeding the Group AI programme – building and maintaining the plan, milestones, dependencies, RAID log and financials, and ensuring the workstream delivers against the commitments made into the wider programme.
  • Programme governance and reporting: Run the governance and reporting cycle for the workstream – preparing status reporting, steering and programme board submissions, and ensuring a single, accurate and timely view of progress, risk and value is available to the Group AI programme and to IDP leadership.
  • Cross-workstream integration: Act as IDP's interface into the Group AI programme, managing dependencies with other workstreams, escalating blockers, and ensuring partnership commitments, timelines and benefits are reflected consistently in the overall programme view.
  • Strategy development and execution: Support the Director of IDP in shaping and refreshing the function's strategy – conducting analysis, developing options and recommendations, translating agreed direction into objectives, roadmaps and measurable outcomes, and tracking delivery against them.
  • Operating rhythm and governance: Run the operating rhythm for the Director of IDP and the leadership team – setting agendas, preparing materials, capturing decisions and actions, and driving follow-through to closure.
  • Team effectiveness and organisational health: Support the Director of IDP on organisational and team matters, including onboarding, colleague engagement, internal communications, capability planning and cultural initiatives that sustain a high-performing global team.
  • Special initiatives: Lead strategic initiatives and analyses on behalf of the Director of IDP where dedicated focus is required, from framing the problem through to a decision-ready recommendation and implementation.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Lead the Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream through matrix leadership of contributors across partnership, innovation and technology teams in multiple jurisdictions, without direct line authority.
  • Bring cohesion to the IDP China leadership team – connecting agendas, surfacing tensions early, and holding colleagues to the commitments they have made

Requirements

  • Programme management: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes or workstreams in a large organisation – planning, dependency and risk management, governance, and reporting into senior programme structures.
  • Strategic analysis: Ability to structure ambiguous problems, conduct rigorous analysis, and develop clear, decision-ready recommendations for a senior audience.
  • Executive communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with demonstrable experience producing materials for executive and Board-level audiences.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Strong grasp of engaging with diverse stakeholders, covering business, technology and external partnerships, to align innovation efforts with bank priorities.
  • AI: Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and its practical application in financial services – sufficient to engage credibly with technical colleagues and strategic partners, and to translate technical progress into business terms.
  • Partnerships: Understanding of how strategic technology and AI partnerships are structured, governed and commercially realised within a large, regulated organisation.
  • Strategic: Proven track record in translating strategy into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

/WX/LP

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

Job Summary

  • Providing direct advisory services to customers on portfolio construction and portfolio review;
  • Ensuring SCB offers a differentiated, best-in-class, consistent advisory proposition across customer segments.

This will primarily involve providing professional expert advice to customers using the SCB advisory process for asset allocation, portfolio construction and portfolio review based on the full understanding of the customer's financial position, objectives, risk tolerance and other circumstances (but not including tax status).

The Investment Advisor also acts as a subject matter expert to customers/frontline staff on holistic view of the market, and support SCB wealth strategy in providing to higher value customers a higher level of customer service, and growing recurring income faster than the transaction-based income

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio/Investment Construction and Review for Assigned Customers
  • Partner with 8-12 relationship managers RMs and act as an investment advisor to assigned customers of those RMs. [For IAs Priority Banking, we would seek to provide this portfolio review service to at least the top 25% of Priority customers - as a guideline customers with combined Deposits+WM AUM of $200k & above.]
  • Grow AUM of customers through investment advisory services, by proposing customer-specific portfolio solutions that will drive net growth in customer portfolios.
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • Fully comply with all the regulatory requirements related to Consumer Rights Protection, uphold the robust mindset of Consumer Rights Protection, complete the Consumer Rights Protection themed training and workshop in due course, prevent the potential infringements of consumer rights, participate the public education, EV or other activities to uplift the public awareness about Consumer Rights Protection

Strategy

  • Based on materials issued by Group and Country Investment Advisory and Strategy teams, provide market briefings for RMs/branches/Hubs
  • Based on materials issued by Group and Country Wealth Solutions teams, provide updates on investment advisory process changes to RMs

Business

  • Portfolio/Investment Diagnostics to Assigned RMs
  • Conduct one-on-one diagnostic reviews with each assigned RM on his/her portfolio at least [once a month], to:
  • Align customer portfolios with their investment objectives, and aligning portfolios with house views
  • Balance asset allocation and thematic plays

Processes

  • Provide investment consultation in the customers’ best interests using the SCB advisory process, rather than focussing on the sale of specific products.
  • Help the customer to achieve his or her objectives, in the context of the customer's current needs/circumstances, in compliance with all regulatory and bank requirements and with the highest professional standards.

People & Talent

  • Outstanding ability to provide leadership, guidance and inspiration to the customers, RMs and other partners
  • Strong sense of self motivation and discipline in execution
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence outcomes
  • Ability to network with internal and external business stakeholders.

Risk Management

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies

Governance

  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholder

  • WRB Affluent team

Skills And Experience

  • Data Science
  • Investment advisory& portfolio construction
  • Wealth management products(funds, Bonds, structured products, etc.)
  • Data Analysis& digital tools
  • Financial Planning& Asset allocation

Qualifications

  • Investment Advisor: Bachelors Degree with 4 - 8 years in Investment Consulting either within a bank, insurance company or independent financial advisory firm
  • Senior Investment Advisor: Bachelors Degree with minimum 10 years in Investment Consulting either within a bank, insurance company or independent financial advisory firm
  • With Onshore Mutual Certification

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do

Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

Financial Markets has expertise combined with deep local market knowledge to deliver a variety of risk management, financing and investment solutions to our clients. The FM team offers capabilities across origination, structuring, sales, trading and research. Offering a full suite of fixed income, currencies, commodities, equities and capital markets solutions, FM has firmly established itself as a trusted partner with extensive on-the-ground knowledge and deep relationships.

Within FM, the Modelling & Analytics Group (‘MAG’) is accountable for design, development and delivery of real-time pricing models, risk models, and core infrastructure, enabling pricing, market data, intra-day risk reporting capability, and portfolio level analytics including reporting and capital optimization.

The role of Associate, Quantitative Analysis, will work in MAG’s Shanghai location, focusing primarily upon model development, testing, documentation, offer quantitative solutions to reginal and international Financial Market (FM) business cross asset classes, with these activities critical to supporting independent review of models, governance approval, regulatory engagement, and business activities.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Maintain and extend the in-house multi-asset class pricing and risk library used across the bank, for all types of products, including flow, vanilla and exotics in a specific asset class.
  • Produce analytics documentation and test material and outputs
  • Provide day-to-day support for all relevant business units
  • Improve existing and implement risk and regulatory related analytics

Strategy

  • Provide quantitative solutions to support business in generating revenue for the bank
  • Understand front office concerns in order to bridge the gap between the front office and back office
  • Focus on products, model, and strategy’s development, maintenance, testing and documentation.

Business

  • Work closely with FM traders and structuring teams, analysing trades and asset origination opportunities for execution and ongoing measurement and management.
  • Maintain and develop cutting edge trading, pricing and multi assets risk management quantitative library and applications.

Title SI Solutions - Analyst, Proxy Voting

Department Asset Management CAO

Location Dalian

Level: 2

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Fidelity Dalian

Established in 2007, FIL Technology (Dalian) Limited was the Fidelity’s first wholly owned enterprise in China. The Dalian office initially served as a systems development centre to bolster Fidelity’s growing business in the Asia Pacific region, with a primary focus on providing technology and web-based support and services. The office has continued to expand in recent years and now acts as the central service hub for the Asia Pacific region supporting multiple business functions including systems development and support, systems infrastructure support, retail operations, finance accounting services and investment administration & fund accounting.

About Your Team

Asset Management CAO team is responsible front to back, for the operational and supporting capabilities across investment management. The Investment Management Solutions team is a cross asset delivery & support function driving collaboration, consistency & execution across the global asset management platform. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the Sustainable Investing Solutions team is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.

About Your Role

As the SI Solutions - Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting the firm’s stewardship activities. Your responsibilities will include analyzing shareholder meeting agendas, providing insightful voting recommendations, and executing high‑quality, timely proxy votes in alignment with the firm’s policies and fiduciary duties. You will also contribute to policy development and ongoing process improvements. In this role, you will collaborate closely with investment teams, Sustainable Investing analysts, and proxy service providers to strengthen the firm’s governance framework and enhance our stewardship outcomes.

About You

The successful candidate will be a detail‑oriented governance professional with demonstrated expertise in applying in‑house voting policies and conducting precise research on investee AGM/EGM agendas. This role requires performing accurate analysis in complex or non‑standard voting scenarios and consistently delivering timely, high‑quality voting instructions. With a growing understanding of Sustainable Investing functions, the candidate is expected to operate with strong process discipline, overseeing end‑to‑end vote execution, quality assurance, and pipeline management. As the global regulations related to Sustainable Investing continue to evolve rapidly, the candidate must be able to learn, adapt, and refine deliverables to meet emerging requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze FIL Investee companies’ global shareholder meeting agendas, focusing on complex corporate governance, remuneration, and ESG related proposals.
  • Conduct researches and FIL voting policy application by leveraging FIL’s research capabilities, in-house voting policy, and external research resources to make thorough and informed voting recommendations for Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team.
  • Assist Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team in engagement activities with investee companies on governance and sustainability topics.
  • Handle end-to-end vote execution processes to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Provide non-standard voting support to address specific client requirements.
  • Coordinate with external proxy advisors, custodians, and voting platforms to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Contribute to periodic reviews and updates of proxy voting policies and procedures. Monitor regulatory and market developments in governance, stewardship, and ESG.
  • Support the preparation of stewardship reports, respond to client inquiries, and complete regulatory disclosures.
  • Support the implementation of new voting strategies and practices, and identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvementation.
  • Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.

Experience And Qualifications Required

  • Education in Finance, Business, Economics, Sustainability Investment or related field. Master degree is preferred.
  • Experience in researches and analysis in proxy voting, corporate governance, stewardship, ESG or Sustainable Investing is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to interpret corporate filings and governance documents.
  • Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail and accuracy in a high volume, deadline driven environment.
  • Data analytical and automation skills (Python/SQL/PowerBI), experience of developing automation for business processes is highly preferred. Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
  • Proficient in using AI tools to improve efficiency, ensure accuracy, and solve business problems.
  • Highly efficient English communication skills, both written and verbal is mandatory.
  • Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA, FRM related certificate is highly preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
  • Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is required. Proven record to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
  • A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
  • Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.

As the SI Solutions - Analyst , you will play a key role in supporting the firm’s stewardship activities. Your responsibilities will include analyzing shareholder meeting agendas, providing insightful voting recommendations, and executing high‑quality, timely proxy votes in alignment with the firm’s policies and fiduciary duties. You will also contribute to policy development and ongoing process improvements. In this role, you will collaborate closely with investment teams, Sustainable Investing analysts, and proxy service providers to strengthen the firm’s governance framework and enhance our stewardship outcomes.
About You
The successful candidate will be a detail‑oriented governance professional with demonstrated expertise in applying in‑house voting policies and conducting precise research on investee AGM/EGM agendas. This role requires performing accurate analysis in complex or non‑standard voting scenarios and consistently delivering timely, high‑quality voting instructions. With a growing understanding of Sustainable Investing functions, the candidate is expected to operate with strong process discipline, overseeing end‑to‑end vote execution, quality assurance, and pipeline management. As the global regulations related to Sustainable Investing continue to evolve rapidly, the candidate must be able to learn, adapt, and refine deliverables to meet emerging requirements.
Key Responsibilities
- Review and analyze FIL Investee companies’ global shareholder meeting agendas, focusing on complex corporate governance, remuneration, and ESG related proposals.
- Conduct researches and FIL voting policy application by leveraging FIL’s research capabilities, in-house voting policy, and external research resources to make thorough and informed voting recommendations for Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team.
- Assist Sustainability Investment Analysts and Investment management team in engagement activities with investee companies on governance and sustainability topics.
- Handle end-to-end vote execution processes to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance. Provide non-standard voting support to address specific client requirements.
- Coordinate with external proxy advisors, custodians, and voting platforms to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
- Contribute to periodic reviews and updates of proxy voting policies and procedures. Monitor regulatory and market developments in governance, stewardship, and ESG.
- Support the preparation of stewardship reports, respond to client inquiries, and complete regulatory disclosures.
- Support the implementation of new voting strategies and practices, and identify, drive and contribute to continuous process improvementation.
- Develop & maintain consolidated, auditable process documentation library.
Experience And Qualifications Required
- Education in Finance, Business, Economics, Sustainability Investment or related field. Master degree is preferred.
- Experience in researches and analysis in proxy voting, corporate governance, stewardship, ESG or Sustainable Investing is a strong plus.
- Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to interpret corporate filings and governance documents.
- Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail and accuracy in a high volume, deadline driven environment.
- Data analytical and automation skills (Python/SQL/PowerBI), experience of developing automation for business processes is highly preferred. Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
- Proficient in using AI tools to improve efficiency, ensure accuracy, and solve business problems.

- Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA, FRM related certificate is highly preferred.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
- Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is required. Proven record to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
- A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
- Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.

And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us.   • Deep multi-assent knowledge and portfolio construction skills (funds, Bonds, structured products, etc.)

  • Data Analysis& Digital tools

  • Investment Advisor: Bachelor’s Degree with 4 - 8 years in Investment Consulting either within a bank, insurance company or independent financial advisory firm

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other.   • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Associate, Business Analyst to support the continued enhancement of the Banca platform within Wealth Digital Products and Proposition. The role focuses on analysing business requirements, understanding end-to-end bancassurance journeys and user workflows, documenting functional solutions, and supporting delivery of technology initiatives that improve client, frontline, partner, and operational outcomes.

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, engineers, operations teams, insurance partners, and delivery squads to translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process flows, and test scenarios. This role is well suited for candidates with bancassurance, insurance distribution, Wealth Management, digital sales, or financial-services platform experience, together with strong business analysis and stakeholder management skills.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Support Product Owners in shaping and refining feature scope, backlog priorities, and release plans based on business value, user feedback, and operational needs.
  • Provide domain input on Banca platform journeys, product configuration, policy servicing, partner integrations, and enhancement opportunities to support platform evolution.
  • Use client and frontline feedback, production issues, operational insights, and service metrics to recommend incremental improvements to Banca journeys and workflows.

Business

  • Elicit, analyse, and document business requirements and functional needs.
  • Analyse end-to-end bancassurance journeys covering product discovery, needs analysis, quotation, application, submission, policy issuance, and servicing.
  • Capture business rules, product configuration, eligibility, consent, disclosure, document, and integration requirements across markets and insurance partners.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business objectives into user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Conduct impact assessments and support solution design discussions.
  • Facilitate workshops and stakeholder interviews to understand business challenges and opportunities.

Processes

  • Support backlog preparation, requirements clarification, and sprint planning activities.
  • Define test scenarios and support UAT, defect triage, and production validation.
  • Support end-to-end and partner-integration validation across upstream channels, the Banca platform, insurer services, and downstream operational systems.
  • Analyse process inefficiencies and recommend improvements to business workflows and user experience.
  • Ensure traceability from requirements through implementation and testing.

People & Talent

  • Work closely with Product Owners, engineers, operations teams, and business users to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and maintain comprehensive functional documentation.

Risk Management

  • Identify functional, operational, and control impacts of proposed changes, and raise risks, issues, or dependencies in a timely manner.
  • Assess customer suitability, consent, disclosure, data privacy, conduct, and operational-control impacts in Banca journeys, escalating gaps promptly.
  • Maintain awareness of conduct, compliance, and operational risk considerations relevant to product changes and day-to-day delivery.
  • Support timely resolution of defects or change issues that may affect user outcomes, controls, or service stability.

Governance

  • Ensure requirements, testing artefacts, and change documentation meet internal governance, control, and delivery standards, including ESDLC expectations.
  • Maintain accurate and traceable documentation for features, enhancements, and testing outcomes.
  • Ensure delivered changes are aligned with applicable policies, standards, and regulatory obligations.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key Stakeholders

  • Product Owners
  • Bancassurance product and business teams
  • Insurance partners and integration teams
  • Engineering Lead
  • Domain Tech Lead
  • Agile delivery squad members
  • Business users and stakeholders across bancassurance sales, servicing, and operations workflows
  • Operations and support teams

Skills And Experience

  • Software Product Business Knowledge

Knowledge of and experience with the business aspects and operation of a software product; knowledge of the install base, current uses, future plans, and product vision.

  • Requirements Analysis
  • Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  • Software Change Request Management
  • Knowledge of, and experience with, managing product change requests from customers, prospective customers, vendors, and internal staff.
  • Scrum
  • Knowledge of the principles, components and features of scrum methodology; ability to apply this methodology to manage software product development processes.
  • Release Management
  • Knowledge of activities, practices, deliverables and application release techniques; ability to manage and control the implementation of new or enhanced applications into a production/live environment.
  • Application Delivery Process
  • Knowledge of major tasks, deliverables, and formal application delivery methodologies; ability to utilize these in order to deliver new or enhanced applications.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree, or higher, in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Training

  • Typically 8 or more years of relevant experience financial services, including 3-5 years in Business Analysis, Functional Analysis, Product Delivery, or Technology Delivery roles.
  • Strong understanding of bancassurance or insurance distribution, including digital sales journeys, needs analysis, quotation, application and submission, underwriting hand-offs, policy issuance, servicing, and partner integration. Candidates with broader Wealth Management, insurance, digital banking, CRM, onboarding, or sales-platform experience and demonstrable exposure to regulated customer journeys will also be considered.
  • Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, user stories, current- and target-state process flows, acceptance criteria, business rules, data mappings, and functional specifications.
  • Experience supporting Agile delivery teams, backlog refinement, system and integration testing, UAT, defect management, release readiness, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technology stakeholders.

Technical Skills

  • Translate and articulate technical requirements clearly, ensuring alignment between business needs and technical implementation through detailed analysis
  • Ability to understand system workflows, APIs, partner integrations, data flows, document generation, notifications, and technical constraints, and to collaborate effectively with engineering teams during solution design and delivery.
  • Experience working with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, SQL, or similar delivery and analysis tools.

Languages

  • Proficient in Business English and Mandarin (written and verbal communication).

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

Android Application Development

  • Design, build, and maintain Android applications and reusable components aligned to agreed architecture and engineering best practices.
  • Develop customer-centric user experiences using modern Android UI frameworks (Jetpack Compose and/or XML Views) and implement robust application logic using current Android development approaches.
  • Integrate applications with backend services and APIs, ensuring reliability, performance, and secure data handling.
  • Contribute directly to feature delivery, bug fixing, and technical improvements across the mobile codebase.
  • Partner with product and design to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.

Engineering Quality and Governance

  • Ensure high-quality code through clean architecture, unit testing, and peer code reviews.
  • Follow governance processes to ensure long-view technical design is in place for robustness, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Drive performance optimisation, stability improvements, and secure coding practices appropriate for banking-grade applications.
  • Maintain and improve development standards, including coding guidelines, branching strategies, release readiness checks, and technical documentation.

Issue Resolution

  • Identify and diagnose complex technical issues across devices, Android OS versions, OEM variations, and integration points.
  • Develop and implement effective solutions in a timely manner, collaborating with other engineers where needed.
  • Maintain a clear log of issues and resolutions, providing structured updates to stakeholders (including risks, mitigations, and timelines).

Continuous Improvement

  • Gather feedback from users and internal teams to identify areas for improvement in the Android app and development lifecycle.
  • Work closely with platform and engineering teams to implement enhancements and optimisations based on feedback and data (e.g., crash analytics, performance metrics).
  • Stay up to date with Android ecosystem changes (SDK updates, Jetpack libraries, Play policies, security guidance), incorporating relevant advancements into the team’s approach.
  • Contribute to documentation, including developer guides, FAQs, and troubleshooting tips to support maintainability and onboarding.

Communication and Collaboration

  • Maintain open lines of communication with product, design, QA, security, and backend teams, providing regular updates on progress and risks.
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings to share insights and collaborate on mobile-related initiatives.
  • Foster a positive, supportive environment that encourages knowledge sharing, mentoring, and teamwork.

Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving abilities, with a proven track record of resolving complex technical issues.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects and priorities.
  • Strong experience with version control (Git) and modern branching/release practices.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins (or equivalent).
  • Good understanding of Android performance optimisation (startup time, rendering, memory, battery) and secure coding best practices.
  • Experience integrating mobile apps with cloud services and APIs (REST/GraphQL), including authentication and secure session handling.
  • Working knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
  • Minimum 3+ years of professional Android development experience, including recent experience delivering production apps.Proficiency in Kotlin (and understanding of Java where required).
  • Strong understanding of Android app architecture and patterns (e.g., MVVM, Clean Architecture), modularisation, and dependency injection (e.g., Hilt/Dagger/Koin).
  • Experience building UI with Jetpack Compose (preferred) and/or Android Views, including state management and complex UI rendering.
  • Experience with Android Jetpack libraries (e.g., ViewModel, Navigation, Room/DataStore, WorkManager).
  • Solid understanding of concurrency and async programming (Coroutines/Flow, threading).
  • Experience with testing practices: unit testing (JUnit), UI testing (Espresso/Compose UI), and testability by design.
  • Awareness of security expectations for mobile banking (e.g., secure storage, encryption, certificate pinning/transport security, OWASP MASVS concepts).

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets.   • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Job Summary

This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
  • Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
  • Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
  • Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
  • Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
  • Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.

Business

  • Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
  • Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
  • Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
  • Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
  • Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
  • Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.

People and Talent

  • Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
  • Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
  • Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
  • Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.

Governance

  • Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
  • Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
  • Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
  • Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.

Regulatory and Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
  • Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
  • Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
  • Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
  • Responsible for building a culture of good conduct

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 6+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
  • Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
  • Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.

The Research Associate is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the sub function/ job family. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

Responsibilities

  • Reviews and processes broker votes to be shared and consumed
  • Organizes the product management team including creation of presentations, marketing schedules, coordination of the marketing diary, product planning meetings, diary management etc.
  • Publishes focus list notes, updating and displaying the new focus list posters etc.
  • Contributes to market data and subscriptions management for Equity Research
  • Responsible for collation, co-ordination and organization of Road Ahead conference, stock steering meetings
  • Assists with year-end scorecard preparation, result analysis, goals and training
  • Provides management information including variance analysis, month-end reporting etc.
  • Conducts expense management including travel and entertainment pre-approvals, client interaction spend pre-approval e.g. GLG, non-network individuals etc.
  • Manages and prepares Committee quality reviews
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • MBA and/or CFA preferred
  • Existing knowledge of Research or external Investment research division essential
  • History of working within tight deadlines and prioritization
  • Microsoft systems especially Excel and Word
  • Ability to interact and manage at all levels ability to manage large amounts of data ability to use internal Citi systems would be an advantage but is not essential.
  • Accuracy and attention to detail
  • Secure and maintain applicable licenses


Education

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience
